comment: ONE task pursuit -- the merge of the two delegation paths. Any goal is a wants_done Task; the agent makes ONE route decision -- do it MYSELF (kind-specific: fetch=propose a trade; else just do it) or ASK the cheapest CAPABLE person I can afford -- and dispatches. Delegation is the 'ask' route, not a separate faculty. The food-acquire need mints a fetch task; a note is a task too. The agents RUN ON THE MAP: going myself means HEADING FOR the source and trading when I ARRIVE (co-located) -- fetching takes ticks to walk there.

rules.name: pu_estimate
rules.comment: Task pursuit -- ESTIMATE THE JOURNEY to the source it expects: the distance (manhattan over my current position and theirs) and the stamina it would cost. src_reach=1 only if my full stamina capacity could cover it -- else the trip is beyond me and I must ask someone. Every agent estimates this for its own expected source -- lets an agent (asker OR asked) look before it leaps: rest if I'm short, decline if it's too far.

rules.name: pu_score_tie
rules.comment: Task pursuit -- cost of asking each person to do this task: their offer (my model - our relationship, priced) + a little ask-effort, but ONLY if they are CAPABLE and I can afford it; else out of reach. One mechanism for ANY task (fetch bread, deliver a note).

rules.name: pu_route
rules.comment: Task pursuit -- the ONE route decision for a goal: cost of doing it MYSELF (my effort, if I am capable and -- for a fetch -- know a source) vs the CHEAPEST PERSON to ask (min over ties). Same decision for every task; delegation is just the 'ask' route. Sets the costs + arms the dispatch. Going myself on a FETCH is out of reach (self_cost BIG) if the journey exceeds my stamina capacity (src_reach 0) -- then I ask someone who can.

rules.name: pu_do_self_fetch
rules.comment: Task pursuit -> act (route MYSELF, a fetch): I HEAD FOR the source I expect (a navigation intent, going_to) -- I do not teleport. The trade happens when I ARRIVE and am co-located (pu_at_source). Walking there takes ticks. (Only when going myself is at least as cheap as asking.) Only set out if I have the STAMINA for the trip now (reserve >= estimate); if I'm short I stay and REST first, then go.

rules.name: pu_do_self_generic
rules.comment: Task pursuit -> act (route MYSELF, a non-fetch task like delivering a note): I carry it out myself and it is done. (When going myself is at least as cheap as asking, and I am capable.)

rules.name: pu_do_ask
rules.comment: Task pursuit -> act (route ASK): when asking the cheapest person beats doing it myself, I ask THEM -- mint a Request carrying the offer I decided. They accept (dl_accept) and carry it out (dx_fetch/dx_deliver for a fetch; the general delegation for anything). ONE ask path for every task -- the merge of the old general + food delegations.

rules.name: pu_at_source
rules.comment: Task pursuit -- ARRIVED at the source: now that I am co-located with the holder I was heading for, I propose the trade for the good (the two-sided, co-located trade). Clears the navigation intent. This is why fetching takes time -- I had to get here.
